text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Central Bank says it will deal decisively with commercial banks found guilty of short-changing customers who withdraw large sums of money.
- Chinese experts commission a locomotive repair workshop as part of project to rehabilitate Nigeria's railways.
- Hadejia Jama'are River Basin Development Authority in northern Nigeria is to spend 6.2 billion naira to irrigate 7,031 hectares of land.
- Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation is set to phase out some of its subsidiaries, which it no longer considers viable.
- A delegation of the Nigerian-South African chamber of commerce is to embark on a one week trade mission to South Africa later this month.
